about.title: Method
about.lead: Hunika compares selling today with storing for 1 to 4 months. It uses the range of past years, and it recommends storage only when the likely gain is clear and the bad case is small.
about.ai: Code and these words were drafted with Grok Build on 25 October 2026. The build guide was written for Claude. The team still reviews the numbers and every Kinyarwanda line.
about.notice: Advice based on past prices, not a guarantee.
about.wfp: WFP retail prices, via HDX, downloaded 25 October 2026. Newest month in the file: August 2026.
about.cpi: NISR rural food CPI through September 2026, published 10 October 2026.
about.sas: NISR Seasonal Agricultural Survey 2025 annual tables, published 31 December 2025.
about.ahs: Agricultural Household Survey 2024 is not in the app yet. It has to be downloaded from the NISR microdata catalog.
